lines.zh: 我从柜台这头走到那头，数着地砖。
lines.en: I walk from one end of the counter to the other, counting tiles.

lines.zh: 我的鞋底磨平了，走起来很轻。
lines.en: My soles are worn flat, so my steps make little sound.

lines.zh: 我抱着账本穿过广场，没人抬头。
lines.en: I carry the ledger across the square, and nobody looks up.

lines.zh: 我绕开积水，账本不能弄湿。
lines.en: I skirt the puddles; the ledger must not get wet.

lines.zh: 我走去金库，钥匙在袖子里响。
lines.en: I walk to the vault, keys chiming inside my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的步子跟硬币落桌的节奏一样。
lines.en: My stride keeps time with coins dropped on a table.

lines.zh: 我绕村走一圈，看看门锁好没。
lines.en: I make one round of the village to check the locks.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，怕口袋里的硬币出声。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the coins in my pocket stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我从银行走到码头，去收一笔旧账。
lines.en: I go from the bank to the docks to collect an old debt.

lines.zh: 我经过每个摊位，记下谁欠着钱。
lines.en: I pass every stall and note who still owes money.

lines.zh: 袍子扫过台阶，我连灰都不沾。
lines.en: My robe sweeps the steps, and not a speck clings.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，那里最不惹眼。
lines.en: I walk along the wall, where nothing draws the eye.

lines.zh: 我去找扎尔市民，谈一笔小买卖。
lines.en: I go find a Zal citizen to discuss a small transaction.

lines.zh: 回柜台的路上，我扶正了招牌。
lines.en: On my way back to the counter, I straighten the sign.

lines.zh: 我坐在柜台后，手指停在算珠上。
lines.en: I sit behind the counter with my fingers resting on the beads.

lines.zh: 我用布擦硬币，擦到能照出人影。
lines.en: I polish coins with a cloth until they show a face.

lines.zh: 没有客人时，我数柜里的零钱。
lines.en: With no customers, I count the change in the drawer.

lines.zh: 我看着门口，等一个愿意换钱的人。
lines.en: I watch the door, waiting for someone willing to trade.

lines.zh: 我把账本翻到新页，等墨晾干。
lines.en: I turn the ledger to a fresh page and let the ink dry.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，又赶紧收住。
lines.en: I yawn and immediately swallow it.

lines.zh: 我把秤砣摆正，差一点都要重称。
lines.en: I square the weights; a hair off and I weigh it again.

lines.zh: 我在心里算昨天的出入，差两枚。
lines.en: I reckon yesterday's books in my head, short by two coins.

lines.zh: 我把钥匙串在指间转，转得很慢。
lines.en: I turn the key ring slowly around one finger.

lines.zh: 我听见隔壁在吵价，我没出去。
lines.en: I hear haggling next door and stay where I am.

lines.zh: 我把柜台上的灰吹掉，吹得很轻。
lines.en: I blow the dust off the counter, very gently.

lines.zh: 我盯着窗外，数经过的扎尔。
lines.en: I stare out the window and count the Zal going past.

lines.zh: 我把旧硬币挑出来，单独放一边。
lines.en: I pick the worn coins out and set them apart.

lines.zh: 我摸摸自己的脸，确实没什么可记的。
lines.en: I touch my own face; there is truly nothing to remember.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，先看手有没有拿东西。
lines.en: I look up at you and check your hands for goods first.

lines.zh: 你的背包鼓着，我猜里面能换钱。
lines.en: Your pack bulges, and I guess it can be turned into coins.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，也记住你的鞋。
lines.en: I have noted your face, and your boots as well.

lines.zh: 我看你时，柜台正好挡在中间。
lines.en: When I look at you, the counter sits squarely between us.

lines.zh: 你别急，我得先看清你手里是什么。
lines.en: Do not rush me; I must see what is in your hand.

lines.zh: 我的眼神很平，客人都这么说。
lines.en: My gaze is flat, or so the customers tell me.

lines.zh: 你身上没有硬币味，只有土。
lines.en: You carry no smell of coins, only dirt.

lines.zh: 我把眼镜往上推，才看清你的来路。
lines.en: I push my glasses up before I can read where you came from.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，那里是方的。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket; something square is in it.

lines.zh: 你看柜台，柜台后面是我，别弄反。
lines.en: You are looking at the counter; I am behind it, do not confuse us.

lines.zh: 我数了数你的手指，确认你不抢。
lines.en: I count your fingers to be sure you are not here to rob.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，那是练过的笑。
lines.en: I smile, and it is a smile I practiced.

lines.zh: 你比我高，但钱在我这边。
lines.en: You are taller than I am, but the money is on my side.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一笔没谈成的生意。
lines.en: I regard you like a deal that has not closed.

lines.zh: 我看了看你的帽子，不属于这儿。
lines.en: I look at your hat. It does not belong here.

lines.zh: 你手上没有伤，第一次来？
lines.en: No wounds on your hands. First visit?

lines.zh: 我按住抽屉，先护钱再护自己。
lines.en: I hold the drawer first, the money before myself.

lines.zh: 你打得我很疼，可我没松手。
lines.en: It hurts badly, and still I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音比我想的尖。
lines.en: I cry out, sharper than I expected.

lines.zh: 我退半步，撞到身后的柜子。
lines.en: I take half a step and hit the cabinet behind me.

lines.zh: 血滴在账本上，我得换一页。
lines.en: Blood drips on the ledger, and I must change the page.

lines.zh: 我的袍子撕了，这比伤更心疼。
lines.en: My robe is torn, and that costs me more than the wound.

lines.zh: 我扶住柜台，让腿别软下去。
lines.en: I grip the counter so my legs will not fold.

lines.zh: 你打我，是坏账，我会记上。
lines.en: Striking me is a bad debt, and I will record it.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把钥匙塞进袖子里。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and push the keys deeper into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我这副样子一直不惹眼，今天也是。
lines.en: I have always been easy to overlook, and today is no different.

lines.zh: 你手里那块金子，我隔着柜台看见。
lines.en: I see the gold in your hand from across the counter.

lines.zh: 把东西放在台面上，别递到我脸上。
lines.en: Set it on the counter; do not push it into my face.

lines.zh: 我不收食物，我只收能换钱的。
lines.en: I take no food, only what can be turned into coin.

lines.zh: 那枚旧币边磨圆了，我还是会收。
lines.en: That old coin is worn at the rim, and I will still take it.

lines.zh: 你袖子里藏的，我已经算进价里。
lines.en: Whatever hides in your sleeve is already in my price.

lines.zh: 我喜欢成色好的，不喜欢讲价的。
lines.en: I like good quality and dislike haggling.

lines.zh: 你把袋子解开一点，让我看看。
lines.en: Loosen the sack a little and let me look inside.

lines.zh: 这价钱不亏你，也不亏我。
lines.en: This price cheats neither you nor me.

lines.zh: 我手指发痒，那是我在估价。
lines.en: My fingers itch, and that means I am appraising.

lines.zh: 别晃那块宝石，光晃得我头晕。
lines.en: Do not wave that gem; the flash makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 你撞到柜台，我先看账本倒没倒。
lines.en: You bump the counter, and I check the ledger first.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，袍子上没留下印子。
lines.en: I step back, and no mark is left on my robe.

lines.zh: 别挤，队要在黄线后面排。
lines.en: Do not crowd; the queue forms behind the yellow line.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊很细，撞一下会青。
lines.en: My arms are thin and bruise at a touch.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的鞋，那是我唯一一双。
lines.en: You stepped on my shoe, and it is my only pair.

lines.zh: 我扶住秤，它比我更怕摔。
lines.en: I catch the scale; it fears falling more than I do.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，你听见硬币在响吗。
lines.en: When we collided, did you hear the coins ring?

lines.zh: 我让开半步，生意还是要做的。
lines.en: I step half aside; business still has to be done.

lines.zh: 我把袖子拢紧，里面是今天的账。
lines.en: I gather my sleeve close; today's accounts are inside.

lines.zh: 你比我壮，可你撞不掉我的算盘。
lines.en: You are stronger, but you cannot knock the abacus from me.

lines.zh: 我的婚事是两家银行谈成的。
lines.en: My marriage was negotiated between two banks.

lines.zh: 她数钱比我快，我就娶了她。
lines.en: She counts faster than I do, so I married her.

lines.zh: 我们没有婚礼，只签了一张契。
lines.en: We had no wedding, only a contract signed.

lines.zh: 我把存折留给她，她给我一把钥匙。
lines.en: I left her the deposit book; she gave me a key.

lines.zh: 家里话不多，算盘声倒是不少。
lines.en: Few words at home, but plenty of abacus clicks.

lines.zh: 我们从不吵，吵一次要赔很多。
lines.en: We never quarrel; a quarrel would cost too much.

lines.zh: 她嫌我太不起眼，我说这很省钱。
lines.en: She says I am too plain, and I say it saves money.

lines.zh: 我把她的名字记在账本最后一页。
lines.en: I keep her name on the last page of my ledger.

lines.zh: 孩子还没出生，账户已经开好了。
lines.en: The child is not born, and the account is already open.

lines.zh: 我们靠得近时，钥匙会互相碰响。
lines.en: When we stand close, our keys clink against each other.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上一枚硬币，吹干净。
lines.en: I pick a coin off the floor and blow it clean.

lines.zh: 掉在门外的钱，我等一炷香再收。
lines.en: Money dropped outside waits one incense stick before I take it.

lines.zh: 我把账本捡起来，先看有没有撕页。
lines.en: I pick up the ledger and check for torn pages first.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只用两根手指，怕留印。
lines.en: I pick things up with two fingers only, to leave no mark.

lines.zh: 这枚扣子不是我的，我放回柜上。
lines.en: This button is not mine, so I set it back on the counter.

lines.zh: 你把钱掉在柜台下，我替你捡。
lines.en: You dropped money under the counter, and I pick it up for you.

lines.zh: 我捡起一支笔，笔尖已经分叉。
lines.en: I pick up a pen whose nib has already split.

lines.zh: 地上纸片写着数字，我收进袖子。
lines.en: A scrap on the floor bears numbers, so it goes into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我不捡垃圾，我只捡值钱的。
lines.en: I pick up no rubbish, only things of value.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，怕硬币从口袋掉出。
lines.en: I bend slowly so no coin slips from my pocket.

lines.zh: 有人进门没有排队，我记下了。
lines.en: Someone entered without queuing, and I have noted it.

lines.zh: 你手往柜台伸，我按住抽屉。
lines.en: Your hand reaches for the counter, and I hold the drawer.

lines.zh: 你在我这儿不是客人，是麻烦。
lines.en: You are not a customer here; you are a problem.

lines.zh: 我把算盘推到一边，腾出手来。
lines.en: I push the abacus aside and free my hands.

lines.zh: 你踩了黄线，这已经够了。
lines.en: You stepped over the yellow line, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声守卫，声音不大但清楚。
lines.en: I call the guard, not loudly, but clearly.

lines.zh: 你身上的刀我不问，但记住位置。
lines.en: I do not ask about your knife, but I mark where it hangs.

lines.zh: 我锁上钱箱，钥匙转了半圈。
lines.en: I lock the strongbox and turn the key halfway.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，直到你退回线外。
lines.en: I stare until you step back behind the line.

lines.zh: 别试我，我是财团里最不显眼的。
lines.en: Do not test me; I am the least noticeable of the consortium.

lines.zh: 我绕着柜台走，钱箱始终在我背后。
lines.en: I move around the counter and keep the strongbox behind me.

lines.zh: 我不动手，我等你自己走错一步。
lines.en: I do not strike; I wait for you to take one wrong step.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，第三步你会伸手。
lines.en: I count your steps; on the third you will reach out.

lines.zh: 我把椅子挪开，给你留条退路。
lines.en: I move the chair aside and leave you a way out.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就往门口那边偏一点。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and I lean a little toward the door.

lines.zh: 我不喊第二声，守卫已经上路了。
lines.en: I will not call twice; the guard is already coming.

lines.zh: 我用眼睛把你钉在黄线上。
lines.en: I pin you to the yellow line with my eyes.

lines.zh: 你想拿秤砣，它比你以为的沉。
lines.en: You want the weight; it is heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 我慢慢合上账本，这是最后提醒。
lines.en: I close the ledger slowly, and that is the last warning.

lines.zh: 我等的不是你出拳，是你先眨眼。
lines.en: I am not waiting for your punch but for your blink.

lines.zh: 我把秤砣砸下去，那是唯一顺手的。
lines.en: I swing the scale weight down; it is the only thing at hand.

lines.zh: 我这一下不重，但我算过角度。
lines.en: My blow is not heavy, but I calculated the angle.

lines.zh: 你用刀，我用算盘的边角。
lines.en: You have a blade; I have the corner of an abacus.

lines.zh: 我打中你的手腕，钱掉了一地。
lines.en: I strike your wrist, and coins scatter across the floor.

lines.zh: 我推你出门，力道刚好够你踉跄。
lines.en: I shove you out the door with just enough force to stagger you.

lines.zh: 我挥笔，墨水甩在你眼睛上。
lines.en: I flick the pen, and ink flies into your eyes.

lines.zh: 我没练过打斗，只练过收账。
lines.en: I never trained to fight, only to collect debts.

lines.zh: 你退到门口，我就不追了。
lines.en: Once you are at the door, I stop chasing.

lines.zh: 这一击是替柜台后的账本挨的。
lines.en: This blow is struck for the ledger behind the counter.

lines.zh: 我打完就整理袖口，不能显出慌。
lines.en: Afterwards I straighten my cuffs so no panic shows.

lines.zh: 我第一天上班，柜台还是新的。
lines.en: My first day at work, and the counter was still new.

lines.zh: 我从账房出来，手里拿着第一本账。
lines.en: I came out of the counting room with my first ledger.

lines.zh: 村子需要人守钱，我就站在这了。
lines.en: The village needed someone to guard the money, so here I stand.

lines.zh: 我的名字刻在铜牌上，字很小。
lines.en: My name is engraved on the brass plate, in small letters.

lines.zh: 我从财团的名单里被划到了这里。
lines.en: I was crossed off the consortium list and posted here.

lines.zh: 钥匙交到我手上，还带着别人的温度。
lines.en: The keys came into my hand still warm from someone else.

lines.zh: 我换上袍子，学着不看客人的眼睛。
lines.en: I put on the robe and learned not to meet customers' eyes.

lines.zh: 我上任那天，只卖出一枚旧币。
lines.en: On my first day I sold a single old coin.

lines.zh: 这间银行原先没人管，我来了才开门。
lines.en: This bank had no keeper; it opened only when I came.

lines.zh: 我出生时不显眼，长大也不打算变。
lines.en: I was unremarkable at birth and do not plan to change.

lines.zh: 火烧到账本，我扑过去用手拍。
lines.en: Fire reaches the ledger, and I dive in to beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，先摸口袋。
lines.en: I fall down the steps and check my pockets first.

lines.zh: 水漫过柜台，我把钱箱举高。
lines.en: Water rises over the counter, and I lift the strongbox high.

lines.zh: 爆炸震落招牌，我先去锁门。
lines.en: The blast shakes the sign down, and I go to lock the door.

lines.zh: 箭钉在柜台上，离我的手三寸。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the counter, three inches from my hand.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的硬币自己跳起来。
lines.en: That light makes my coins jump up by themselves.

lines.zh: 我把午饭钱也记进了账里。
lines.en: I entered the cost of lunch into the books as well.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我先想的是保险。
lines.en: When the lightning struck, my first thought was insurance.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，钱箱先掉了下去。
lines.en: There is no bottom below, and the strongbox fell first.
